passages.text: Then the angel showed me a river of the water of life, as clear as crystal, flowing from the throne of God and of the Lamb down the middle of the main street of the city. On either side of the river stood a tree of life, bearing twelve kinds of fruit and yielding a fresh crop for each month. And the leaves of the tree are for the healing of the nations.
passages.sermon:
An angel appeared to me.
The angel showed me a river.
This river held the water of life.
The water was bright and clear.
It was as clear as crystal.
The river flowed from the throne of God.
The river also flowed from the throne of the Lamb.
The river ran down the middle of the city's main street.
A tree of life stood on each side of the river.
The tree of life produced twelve kinds of fruit.
Each month, the tree gave its fruit.
The leaves of the tree brought healing to the nations.
passages.original: Καὶ ἔδειξέν μοι ποταμὸν ὕδατος ζωῆς λαμπρὸν ὡς κρύσταλλον ἐκπορευόμενον ἐκ τοῦ θρόνου τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ τοῦ Ἀρνίου ἐν μέσῳ τῆς πλατείας αὐτῆς καὶ τοῦ ποταμοῦ ἐντεῦθεν καὶ ἐκεῖθεν ξύλον ζωῆς ποιοῦν καρποὺς δώδεκα κατὰ μῆνα ἕκαστον ἀποδιδοῦν τὸν καρπὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ φύλλα τοῦ ξύλου εἰς θεραπείαν τῶν ἐθνῶν

passages.text: No longer will there be any curse. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be within the city, and His servants will worship Him.
passages.sermon:
There will be no more curse.
God will place His throne in the city.
The Lamb will also have His throne there.
God’s servants will worship Him.
passages.original: Καὶ πᾶν κατάθεμα οὐκ ἔσται ἔτι καὶ ὁ θρόνος τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ τοῦ Ἀρνίου ἐν αὐτῇ ἔσται καὶ οἱ δοῦλοι αὐτοῦ λατρεύσουσιν αὐτῷ

passages.text: They will see His face, and His name will be on their foreheads.
passages.sermon: God will be present with His people.\r\nHis servants will see His face.\r\nHis name will be on their foreheads.
passages.original: καὶ ὄψονται τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ καὶ τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τῶν μετώπων αὐτῶν

passages.text: There will be no more night in the city, and they will have no need for the light of a lamp or of the sun. For the Lord God will shine on them, and they will reign forever and ever.
passages.sermon:
God will be present in the city.
There will never be night in the city.
People will not need the light of a lamp.
They will not need the light of the sun.
The Lord God will shine on them.
God’s people will reign forever and ever.
passages.original: καὶ νὺξ οὐκ ἔσται ἔτι καὶ οὐκ ἔχουσιν χρείαν φωτὸς λύχνου καὶ φωτὸς ἡλίου ὅτι Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς φωτίσει ἐπ’ αὐτούς καὶ βασιλεύσουσιν εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων

passages.text: Then the angel said to me, “These words are faithful and true. The Lord, the God of the spirits of the prophets, has sent His angel to show His servants what must soon take place.”
passages.sermon:
The angel spoke to me.
He said, “These words are faithful.
These words are true.
The Lord is God.
He is the God of the spirits of the prophets.
The Lord sent His angel.
The angel came to show His servants what must soon happen.”
passages.original: Καὶ εἶπέν μοι Οὗτοι οἱ λόγοι πιστοὶ καὶ ἀληθινοί καὶ ὁ Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς τῶν πνευμάτων τῶν προφητῶν ἀπέστειλεν τὸν ἄγγελον αὐτοῦ δεῖξαι τοῖς δούλοις αὐτοῦ ἃ δεῖ γενέσθαι ἐν τάχει

passages.text: “Behold, I am coming soon. Blessed is the one who keeps the words of prophecy in this book.”
passages.sermon: Jesus speaks.\r\nJesus says, “I am coming soon.”\r\nAnyone who obeys the words of prophecy in this book is blessed.
passages.original: Καὶ ἰδοὺ ἔρχομαι ταχύ μακάριος ὁ τηρῶν τοὺς λόγους τῆς προφητείας τοῦ βιβλίου τούτου

passages.text: And I am John, who heard and saw these things. And when I had heard and seen them, I fell down to worship at the feet of the angel who had shown me these things.
passages.sermon:
I am John.
I heard these things.
I saw these things.
The angel showed me these things.
When I heard them, I fell down.
When I saw them, I fell down.
I tried to worship at the feet of the angel who showed me these things.
passages.original: Κἀγὼ Ἰωάννης ὁ ἀκούων καὶ βλέπων ταῦτα καὶ ὅτε ἤκουσα καὶ ἔβλεψα ἔπεσα προσκυνῆσαι ἔμπροσθεν τῶν ποδῶν τοῦ ἀγγέλου τοῦ δεικνύοντός μοι ταῦτα

passages.text: But he said to me, “Do not do that! I am a fellow servant with you and your brothers the prophets, and with those who keep the words of this book. Worship God!”
passages.sermon:
The angel spoke to me.
He said, “Do not do that.”
I am a servant like you.
I am also a servant with your brothers.
Your brothers are the prophets.
I am a servant with those who keep the words of this book.
Worship God.”
passages.original: καὶ λέγει μοι Ὅρα μή σύνδουλός σού εἰμι καὶ τῶν ἀδελφῶν σου τῶν προφητῶν καὶ τῶν τηρούντων τοὺς λόγους τοῦ βιβλίου τούτου τῷ Θεῷ προσκύνησον

passages.text: Then he told me, “Do not seal up the words of prophecy in this book, because the time is near.
passages.sermon:
An angel spoke to me, John.
The angel had shown me these things.
The angel said, “Do not seal up the words of the prophecy in this book.
The time is near.”
passages.original: Καὶ λέγει μοι Μὴ σφραγίσῃς τοὺς λόγους τῆς προφητείας τοῦ βιβλίου τούτου ὁ καιρὸς γὰρ ἐγγύς ἐστιν

passages.text: Let the unrighteous continue to be unrighteous, and the vile continue to be vile; let the righteous continue to practice righteousness, and the holy continue to be holy.”
passages.sermon:
The unrighteous person continues to do wrong.
The vile person continues to be vile.
The righteous person continues to do what is right.
The holy person continues to be holy.
passages.original: ὁ ἀδικῶν ἀδικησάτω ἔτι καὶ ὁ ῥυπαρὸς ῥυπανθήτω ἔτι καὶ ὁ δίκαιος δικαιοσύνην ποιησάτω ἔτι καὶ ὁ ἅγιος ἁγιασθήτω ἔτι

passages.text: “Behold, I am coming soon, and My reward is with Me, to give to each one according to what he has done.
passages.sermon:
Jesus is speaking.
Jesus says, "I am coming soon."
I bring My reward with Me.
I will give to each person according to what that person has done.
passages.original: Ἰδοὺ ἔρχομαι ταχύ καὶ ὁ μισθός μου μετ’ ἐμοῦ ἀποδοῦναι ἑκάστῳ ὡς τὸ ἔργον ἐστὶν αὐτοῦ

passages.text: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.”
passages.sermon:
Jesus speaks these words.
Jesus is the one who is coming soon.
Jesus brings a reward for each person.
Jesus says, “I am the Alpha and the Omega.”
Alpha is the first letter of the Greek alphabet.
Omega is the last letter of the Greek alphabet.
Jesus is the First.
Jesus is the Last.
Jesus is the Beginning.
Jesus is the End.
passages.original: ἐγὼ τὸ Ἄλφα καὶ τὸ Ὦ ὁ πρῶτος καὶ ὁ ἔσχατος ἡ ἀρχὴ καὶ τὸ τέλος

passages.text: Blessed are those who wash their robes, so that they may have the right to the tree of life and may enter the city by its gates.
passages.sermon: Blessed are those who wash their robes.\r\nThey have the right to the tree of life.\r\nThey may enter the city by its gates.
passages.original: Μακάριοι οἱ πλύνοντες τὰς στολὰς αὐτῶν ἵνα ἔσται ἡ ἐξουσία αὐτῶν ἐπὶ τὸ ξύλον τῆς ζωῆς καὶ τοῖς πυλῶσιν εἰσέλθωσιν εἰς τὴν πόλιν

passages.text: But outside are the dogs, the sorcerers, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters, and everyone who loves and practices falsehood.
passages.sermon:
Some people remain outside the city.
These people do not enter through the gates.
The dogs are outside.
The sorcerers are outside.
The sexually immoral are outside.
The murderers are outside.
The idolaters are outside.
Everyone who loves falsehood is outside.
Everyone who practices falsehood is outside.
passages.original: ἔξω οἱ κύνες καὶ οἱ φάρμακοι καὶ οἱ πόρνοι καὶ οἱ φονεῖς καὶ οἱ εἰδωλολάτραι καὶ πᾶς φιλῶν καὶ ποιῶν ψεῦδος

passages.text: “I, Jesus, have sent My angel to give you this testimony for the churches. I am the Root and the Offspring of David, the bright Morning Star.”
passages.sermon:
Jesus speaks to the people in the churches.
Jesus sends His angel to give this message.
Jesus gives this testimony for the churches.
Jesus is the Root of David.
Jesus is the Offspring of David.
Jesus is the bright Morning Star.
passages.original: Ἐγὼ Ἰησοῦς ἔπεμψα τὸν ἄγγελόν μου μαρτυρῆσαι ὑμῖν ταῦτα ἐπὶ ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις ἐγώ εἰμι ἡ ῥίζα καὶ τὸ γένος Δαυίδ ὁ ἀστὴρ ὁ λαμπρός ὁ πρωϊνός

passages.text: The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” Let the one who hears say, “Come!” And let the one who is thirsty come, and the one who desires the water of life drink freely.
passages.sermon:
The Spirit speaks.
The Spirit says, "Come!"
The bride speaks.
The bride says, "Come!"
Anyone who hears must also say, "Come!"
Anyone who is thirsty may come.
Anyone who wants the water of life may take it freely.
passages.original: Καὶ τὸ Πνεῦμα καὶ ἡ νύμφη λέγουσιν Ἔρχου καὶ ὁ ἀκούων εἰπάτω Ἔρχου καὶ ὁ διψῶν ἐρχέσθω ὁ θέλων λαβέτω ὕδωρ ζωῆς δωρεάν

passages.text: I testify to everyone who hears the words of prophecy in this book: If anyone adds to them, God will add to him the plagues described in this book.
passages.sermon:
I speak to everyone who hears the words of prophecy in this book.
I give my testimony to each person who listens.
If anyone adds to these words, God will act.
God will add to that person the plagues written in this book.
passages.original: Μαρτυρῶ ἐγὼ παντὶ τῷ ἀκούοντι τοὺς λόγους τῆς προφητείας τοῦ βιβλίου τούτου ἐάν τις ἐπιθῇ ἐπ’ αὐτά ἐπιθήσει ὁ Θεὸς ἐπ’ αὐτὸν τὰς πληγὰς τὰς γεγραμμένας ἐν τῷ βιβλίῳ τούτῳ

passages.text: And if anyone takes away from the words of this book of prophecy, God will take away his share in the tree of life and the holy city, which are described in this book.
passages.sermon:
This book contains prophecy.
God gave these words.
Anyone who removes words from this book removes part of God’s message.
God will act if someone takes away from these words.
God will take away that person’s share in the tree of life.
God will also take away that person’s share in the holy city.
The tree of life and the holy city are described in this book.
passages.original: καὶ ἐάν τις ἀφέλῃ ἀπὸ τῶν λόγων τοῦ βιβλίου τῆς προφητείας ταύτης ἀφελεῖ ὁ Θεὸς τὸ μέρος αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τοῦ ξύλου τῆς ζωῆς καὶ ἐκ τῆς πόλεως τῆς ἁγίας τῶν γεγραμμένων ἐν τῷ βιβλίῳ τούτῳ

passages.text: He who testifies to these things says, “Yes, I am coming soon.” Amen. Come, Lord Jesus!
passages.sermon:
Jesus is the one who testifies to these things.
Jesus says, "Yes, I am coming soon."
We say, "Amen."
We say, "Come, Lord Jesus!"
passages.original: Λέγει ὁ μαρτυρῶν ταῦτα Ναί ἔρχομαι ταχύ Ἀμήν ἔρχου Κύριε Ἰησοῦ

passages.text: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with all the saints. Amen.
passages.sermon: The Lord Jesus gives grace.\r\nHe gives this grace to all the saints.\r\nAmen.
passages.original: Ἡ χάρις τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ μετὰ πάντων ἁγίων Ἀμήν
